archetype: 6 (Vibrant Play) infused with premium tactile elements
core_philosophy: Ethical gamification. The app must feel rewarding, elastic, and premium. Avoid the 'cheap spammy' look typical of earning apps by using generous spacing, heavy font weights, soft shadows, and high-quality 3D assets.

typography.font_family_heading: Plus Jakarta Sans (or similar geometric sans like Poppins/Outfit via expo-fonts)
typography.alignment: Strictly left-aligned for data and text. Center alignment is reserved ONLY for empty states and avatars.

buttons.primary: Background #4F46E5, Text #FFFFFF. Full width, 60px height, 20px border radius. MUST include react-native-reanimated scale reduction (0.95) on press-in for tactile feel.
buttons.secondary: Background rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.1), Text #4F46E5. 60px height, 20px border radius.

cards.base: Background #FFFFFF, Border 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.04). Card radius 24px. Padding 20px.
cards.balance_card: Uses the abstract_gradient image as an ImageBackground. Text inside must be pure white with textShadow for legibility.

bottom_tabs.style: Floating tab bar (margin horizontal 16, margin bottom 16, rounded pill) or clean bottom borderless bar with shadow. Active tab should have an energetic color tint.

ads.banner_placeholder: Height 60px. Background #F3F4F6 with subtle diagonal stripes or a dashed border. Label 'Advertisement' in text_muted. Do not make it look broken.

home.header: Row layout. Left: Avatar and 'Hello, User'. Right: Pill-shaped Balance indicator.
home.bento_grid: Ways to Earn MUST follow the 'Bento' protocol. FlexWrap layout. Daily Check-in = 100% width (Hero). Spin Wheel = 48% width. Scratch Card = 48% width. Surveys & Quizzes = 48% width each. Use gap: 4%.
home.campaigns: High Paying Campaigns: Vertical list of cards. Each card has Logo (left), Title & Note (center flex), and Rupee Value (right, green color).

wallet.layout: Large hero gradient balance card at the top. Prominent 'Withdraw to Cash' button. Below: 'Transaction History' as a clean list. Positive points in #10B981, negative in #FF6B6B.

withdraw.layout: Progressive disclosure. Step 1: Select Method (UPI or Bank). Step 2: Input details. Step 3: Withdraw. Display withdrawal history (Pending/Success) via bottom sheet or list below.

profile.layout: Centered avatar overlapping the header. 3-column stats card (Points, Tasks, Streak) using grid/flex. Settings/links represented as a list of rows with Lucide icons (chevron-right on right side).

tasks_gamified.spin_wheel: Large circle divided into segments. Needs a clear 'SPIN' button. Implement via Reanimated rotate styling.
tasks_gamified.scratch_card: Square canvas. Use a 'scratch to reveal' overlay (can be mocked with an animated fade-out mask if native scratch is complex).

motion_guidelines.philosophy: Elasticity creates trust. Buttons should 'squish' like physical rubber. Page transitions should slide smoothly.
motion_guidelines.micro_interactions: Add subtle bounce when balance increases. Add confetti effect (or simple animated particles) on task completion.

images.description: Gold coin stack for wallet and balance indicators
Premium 3D gift box for daily check-in or bonus items
Vibrant abstract gradient for slider banners and the main wallet balance card background
Placeholder avatar for the user profile

instructions_to_main_agent: This is an Expo React Native App. DO NOT use HTML elements (div, span, class). ALWAYS use React Native components (View, Text, Image, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet).
ALWAYS use `testID` prop on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards) to fulfill the testing data-testid requirement.
Use `react-native-reanimated` for motion (button press squish, wheel spin, staggered entrances).
The Admin Panel must be integrated within the app routing (e.g., accessed via a specific hidden flow or login check matching '93altaff@gmail.com').
Apply generous paddings (24px) and large border radii (24px) to avoid the 'cheap UI' feel. Strict adherence to layout bento rules.
